name: rtl-mix
note: Stress RTL/LTR mix (corpus/stress/rtl-mix): one document with an LTR header and an RTL section (direction:rtl) whose logical margins and inline flow mirror, plus an LTR block nested inside the RTL section. Packs per-element direction, logical margin-inline-start and padding-inline-start, text-align start/end under RTL, and a flex row that mirrors its main axis — rendered small (360x640) and desktop (1280x800) with four-layer Chrome parity. Latin text in RTL boxes keeps the test on the default Noto Sans font set (the engine supports direction, not glyph bidi reordering).
